item.title: Badjaos Seek Shelter
item.description: A total of 35 families (272 individuals) from the Badjao community residing in Mabua Beach in Tandag City have been temporarily sheltered at the Mabua Covered Court on Thursday (5 February 2026) as the city implemented pre-emptive evacuation of residents in high-risk areas. MindaNews photo by QUEENIE CASIO

item.description: LINAMON, Lanao del Norte (MindaNews / 5 February) — A power outage hit eight municipalities in Lanao del Norte around 4 p.m. Thursday as Tropical Storm “Basyang” approaches Mindanao, with the province placed at Signal No. 2 Power was restored almost two hours later, according to Lanao del Norte Electric Cooperative, Inc. item.title: Hundreds stranded as sea travel suspended in Northeastern Mindanao
item.description: TANDAG CITY, Surigao del Sur (MindaNews / 5 February) — As Tropical Storm “Basyang” approaches the eastern coast of Mindanao, the suspension of sea travel in the Caraga Region has left 424 passengers stranded and forced 92 vessels and 18 motor bancas to take shelter. item.title: 51,000 affected as Surigao del Sur activates full emergency response
item.description: TANDAG CITY, Surigao del Sur (MindaNews / 5 February) — Over 51,000 people have been affected by Tropical Storm “Basyang” as it continues to bring heavy rainfall, strong winds, and localized flooding in several parts of Surigao del Sur. item.title: ‘Basyang’ in Iligan
item.description: Debris covered Tubod Bridge as Tropical Storm ‘Basyang’ inundated many parts of Iligan City. Photo taken 7:14 a.m. February by the Iligan City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office. Story to follow.

item.title: Rescue in CDO
item.description: Responders from the Cagayan de Oro Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office conduct a rescue operation for residents hit by flooding in Barangay Cugman at dawn Friday (6 February 2026).

item.title: ‘Basyang’ in Agusan del Norte
item.description: Residents wade through a flooded street in Barangay Panaytayon, Remedios T. Romualdez, Agusan del Norte, on Thursday morning, February 6, after Tropical Storm Basyang brought heavy rains overnight to northeastern Mindanao. MindaNews photo by IVY MARIE MANGADLAO

item.description: ILIGAN CITY (MindaNews / 6 February) – A total of 1,258 families or 4,697 individuals from 21 barangays in Iligan City displaced by flooding caused by Tropical Storm “Basyang” have sought refuge at 23 evacuation centers as of 9:30 a.m. Friday, an official said.
